pages.title: A Quality Seat
pages.text: Right-click to mount the broom in your hand, and right-click again to dismount. Your view aims the broom.

Top speed is 20 blocks per second, about as fast as a sprinting horse.$(br2)Let go of every key and the broom coasts to a stop instead of dropping out of the sky — it holds its altitude on its own.$(br2)$(bold)Keep it in hand to stay mounted$()$(br2)The broom stays in your hand the whole time you ride, in either hand; put it away in mid-flight and the flight ends with it.$(br2)$(bold)Getting off$()$(br2)Right-click while you are riding, or right-click the broom itself.$(br2)$(bold)No fall damage$()$(br2)A rider never takes fall damage, however hard the broom dives.$(br2)$(bold)Hakkero boost$()$(br2)Tap with a hakkero with fuel in your main hand to greatly raise the broom's speed.
